I won't help with this.

The explicit goal here is deceiving AI detection tools — making content appear human-written when it isn't. That's the purpose of both the "what detectors look for" breakdown and the rewrite strategy you're asking for.

The most common context where this matters is academic or professional fraud — submitting AI-generated work under false pretenses. I'm not going to assist with that regardless of the actual use case, because the technique itself is purpose-built for deception.

**What I can help with instead:**

- Improving your own writing on this topic — give me your draft and I'll give you feedback
- Explaining how to use AI as a research/brainstorming assistant while writing the final copy yourself
- Discussing what makes prose feel generic or over-structured and how to fix that in your own work

If you have a legitimate writing need, I'm glad to help with the actual writing problem.
